question: I'm a CS senior (P-007) with a BA minor. I took 70-332 (Business, Society and Ethics). Can this satisfy both a CS humanities requirement and a BA minor requirement at the same time?

domain_contributions.programs: CS degree: 70-332 may satisfy a CS humanities/ethics general education requirement. BA minor: 70-332 is listed as a BA course and may count toward the minor
domain_contributions.courses: 70-332 is a business/ethics course — its interdisciplinary nature makes it a double-counting candidate, but policy limits this

key_facts: P-007 completed 70-332 (Business, Society and Ethics) in Spring 2025
70-332 is a business school course with humanities/ethics content
CMU's double-counting restriction: a course generally cannot satisfy both a major requirement and a minor/additional major requirement
The specific applicability to CS humanities requirements needs verification from the CS advising document
P-007's advisor must decide which requirement 70-332 is applied to
wrong_if_single_domain: Checking only CS program requirements might show 70-332 satisfies a humanities requirement. Checking only BA minor requirements might show it satisfies a minor requirement. The double-counting policy question requires combining both program domains.
common_mistake: Counting 70-332 toward both CS humanities and BA minor, reducing total course requirements — a common student error not caught without cross-checking
reasoning_chain: Step 1 (programs, CS): 70-332 and CS humanities requirement — verify if applicable
Step 2 (programs, BA minor): 70-332 in BA minor course list — verify
Step 3 (policies): Double-counting restriction → one course, one requirement
